about: Who narrates explainer clips, and the voice of every cast character. A clip names its map zone (the island ids in game/ui/map.gd, plus foundations) and is narrated by that zone's tutor; recordings go in game/assets/audio/voice/<tutor>/clips/<clip id>/. Tutors are the regional cast from GitHub issue #18; story characters are under 'characters'. Casting was decided by the board on FAL-927 (2026-11-15). An approved voice is fixed: every line is recorded with the same provider, model, voice and direction (word for word) and the same processing. Changing any of them means re-recording every line for that character. Nothing may be recorded for a clip until its tutor is approved. Credit each clip as 'Generated with Gemini text-to-speech (<model>, voice <voice>) via the Gemini API', with the direction and the date.

tin-can-tess.name: Tin-Can Tess
tin-can-tess.direction: A woman in her thirties with a strong, natural New Zealand English accent, clearly Kiwi on every line. A scrapyard mechanic: lively, wry and approachable, a bright voice with a bit of grit, quick to laugh at her own jokes. Grounded and natural, not theatrical. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
tin-can-tess.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

mags-the-ledger.name: Mags the Ledger
mags-the-ledger.direction: A woman in her forties with a strong, natural rural Australian accent, clearly Australian on every line. A low, confident, warm voice with a dry edge, quick-witted and commanding, a trader who enjoys a hard bargain. Grounded and natural, not theatrical or spooky. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
mags-the-ledger.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

rook-dead-air.name: Rook Dead-Air
rook-dead-air.direction: A man in his forties with a strong, unmistakable South African English accent, clearly South African on every line, the flat clipped vowels and crisp consonants of a Johannesburg radio man. A mid-low voice with a slight radio-operator rasp, precise clipped diction, dry and steady, speeds up a little when he gets excited. Grounded and natural, not theatrical. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
rook-dead-air.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

kara-meridian.name: Kara Meridian
kara-meridian.direction: A woman in her forties with a strong, natural Nigerian English accent, clearly Nigerian on every line, the warm, rhythmic, clearly articulated English of Lagos. A desert surveyor who builds her own instruments: measured, confident and calm, a rich mid-low voice. Grounded and natural, not theatrical. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
kara-meridian.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)
kara-meridian.direction_note: Nigerian English comes from the direction only; the voice library has no Nigerian voice. Check each take for drift towards another accent.

lucky-lenoir.name: Lucien "Lucky" Lenoir
lucky-lenoir.direction: A man in his thirties speaking English with a strong, natural French accent, clearly French on every line, but every word easy to understand. A charming wasteland gamesmaster who keeps losing to probability: playful, theatrical and warm, a smooth mid-low voice with a showman's flourish. Natural, not a caricature. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
lucky-lenoir.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)
lucky-lenoir.direction_note: A French voice reading English; the accent comes from the voice.

calc.name: C.A.L.C.
calc.direction: A damaged reactor-maintenance AI. An even, precise, synthetic-sounding voice, slightly flat and clipped, with a dry, deadpan wit and sudden bursts of enthusiasm about rates of change. Clear and steady, every word distinct. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
calc.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then glitch FX (acrusher=bits=8:samples=2:mix=0.45:mode=log,aecho=0.8:0.6:4|9:0.35|0.25,flanger=delay=2:depth=2:regen=50:width=70:speed=0.15), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

bodge.name: Bodge
bodge.direction: An older woman in her sixties, weathered and gruff, with a husky, lived-in rasp and a strong, broad Australian accent. Cheerful and slightly unhinged, with sudden flat deadpan asides, warm underneath. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
bodge.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

gear-mira.name: Gear Mira
gear-mira.direction: A young woman in her late twenties, a practical, patient mechanic and teacher. A warm, grounded voice, calm and clear, who finishes every sentence. Under pressure her sentences get shorter, not louder. Natural, not theatrical. Speaks with a natural Glasgow Scottish accent. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
gear-mira.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

dax.name: Dax
dax.direction: An older man in his late fifties, a friendly, fast-talking wasteland trader. A warm, slightly rough voice, talky and persuasive, long sentences tumbling one into the next, then a short line to close the deal. Natural, not theatrical. Speaks with a natural Newcastle Geordie accent. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
dax.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)

noma.name: Noma
noma.direction: An elderly woman in her seventies, the wise map-keeper of the bazaar. A warm, slow, unhurried voice, a little weathered, sentences that wander and then land exactly. Never hurries, even when the news is bad. Natural, not theatrical. Speaks with a natural Indian English accent. A natural conversational pace, a touch unhurried, with a short natural beat at each comma and full stop.
noma.processing: 2% tape-style slowdown (ffmpeg asetrate=23520,aresample=24000 on the 24 kHz take), then -16 LUFS through a true-peak limit (<= -1.2 dBTP)
